findings.resolution: All 53 references resolve; four captions map directly to XML Fig2/Fig3/Fig4/Fig5

findings.resolution: Discrete tested values [2,4,6] and range [2,6] now explicitly separate

source_and_rights_boundary.package_content: Independently authored factual metadata, original contracts/tests and original prose; source text/media/CAD/code/workbooks excluded

limits: This is a finite exact-pinned trace checker, not a general physical runtime state machine or production evidence authentication
Public deterministic fixtures cannot establish independent real observations, safety authorization or scientific validity
Actor isolation was verified as an explicit one-file projection contract; no deployed ACL, actor loader or sandbox integration was exercised

Full written-source and pixel-reading coverage is inherited from the completed source audit and preserved tool evidence, not independently reread in this review; selected original XML caption identifiers were independently checked before filesystem loss
No videos were played, source workbooks used, peer-review history treated as final authority, or author software acquired or executed
Separately reviewed static-asset availability is compatible with this task boundary; scene/robot geometry remains illustrative and physically unqualified
Rights checks enforce the declared package content boundary; they are not legal advice or permission to reuse source assets
The manifest and verifier provide content integrity, not an external trust signature. Coordinated edits to trusted code and its manifest are outside the threat model

Any release bookkeeping or asset-availability update must be followed by refreezing the manifest and checking exact final archive bytes. The final archive digest belongs in an external release receipt, avoiding a self-referential archive hash
fresh_run_policy: No pre-reset test pass is used as evidence for the recovered bytes. Final delivery requires the exact refrozen archive check.
